step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Pinterest's data access authorization architecture using an internal Token Vending Service and AWS STS. Users authenticate via Kerberos to big data services running on EC2 instances (such as Hadoop). The EC2 credentials provider invokes the Token Vending Service (ThirdParty service). The Token Vending Service looks up user groups in LDAP and translates them into AWS IAM Managed Policies (MP1 and MP2). It then calls AWS STS AssumeRole, passing the base IAM role and managed policies as session policies to generate scoped temporary credentials. These scoped tokens govern access to specific target Amazon S3 buckets.
